About.title: About Me
About.intro: I'm a full-stack developer passionate about building modern web experiences.
About.description: I have strong hands-on experience in Front-end development using React, TypeScript, and atomic design methodology. Additionally, I've used ExpressJS and NestJS with NodeJS runtime for Back-end development. With a solid background in Agile projects, I'm passionate about using my skills to drive innovative solutions and contribute effectively to dynamic, collaborative teams.
About.full: Hello! My name is Nguyen Minh Quan (Kintaro). I am a student pursuing a career in software development with a focus on web technologies, responsive UI engineering, and scalable backend architecture. I love combining design aesthetics with robust functional code to deliver memorable user experiences.

Roadmap.title: Roadmap
Roadmap.description: Key milestones in my growth as a developer and continuous learning journey.

items.description: Started university journey in Computer Science and mastered HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals.
Expanded into modern frontend development with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Built full-stack applications using Next.js App Router, ExpressJS, NestJS, and PostgreSQL.
Refining architecture, UI animations, internationalization, and contributing to open source.
